key_insight: Auxiliary-space multigrid preconditioners let conforming finite element solvers use arbitrarily agglomerated coarse meshes without requiring conforming coarse meshes.
engineering_relevance: The approach offers a flexible route to preconditioning finite element systems on complex engineering geometries.
method: Precondition fine-mesh conforming Lagrange elements using a coarse polytopal DG or hybrid high-order discretisation.
Build subsequent multigrid levels entirely by mesh agglomeration.
Transfer coarse solutions by element-wise interpolation and nodal averaging, with local potential reconstruction for hybrid high-order elements.
evidence_signal: Experiments in 2D and 3D on structured and unstructured meshes with automatically clustered agglomerates support preconditioner robustness.
watch_item: The proven condition-number bound grows as O((H/h)^3), improving to O((H/h)^2) for DG with appropriately scaled penalties, so aggressive coarsening warrants care.
paper_title: Geometric Multigrid Preconditioners for conforming Finite Element Methods on Arbitrarily Agglomerated Meshes
